pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ucce mañce sayati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.3: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto yenāyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa vihāro ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.4: addasa kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.6: āgacchatu me bhante bhagavā sayanaṃ sayatū 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.7: atha kho bhagavā tato 'va paṭinivattitvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.9: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.10: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:1.11.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭhaṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugataṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.4: cattāro mañcā masārako bundikābaddho kuḷirapādako āhaccapādako.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.6: cattāri pīṭhāni masārakaṃ bundikābaddhaṃ kuḷirapādakaṃ āhaccapādakaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.9: aṭṭhaṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugataṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā 'ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.11: taṃ atikkāmetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ, paṭilābhena chinditvā pācittiyaṃ desetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.15: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.16: aññass' atthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc87:2.1.17: aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||1||
